purpose: Trace numeric literals to an inspected table or an explicit analytical reference. Published comparisons are not all same-theory verification.

isotropic_frequency.source: Shimpi, R.P. and Patel, H.G. (2006). Free vibrations of plate using two variable refined plate theory. Journal of Sound and Vibration 296, 979-999.
isotropic_frequency.location: Table 1, printed p. 995, PDF page 17, row (m,n)=(1,1), Mindlin [28] and EXACT [28] columns
isotropic_frequency.status: Verified in the inspected comparison paper; original source [28] was not independently inspected.

comparison_types.elasticity_value: different-model context, not an exact FSDT target

fg_sine_deflection.source: Nguyen, H.N., Hong, T.T., Vinh, P.V., Quang, N.D. and Thom, D.V. (2019). A Refined Simple First-Order Shear Deformation Theory for Static Bending and Free Vibration Analysis of Advanced Composite Plates. Materials 12(15), 2385.
fg_sine_deflection.location: Section 3.1, Table 4, wbar column, SSDT [52] rows Ceramic, 1, 2, 4, 10 and Metal; not the Present rows and not uniform-load Table 3
fg_sine_deflection.attributed_original: Zenkour, A.M. (2006). Generalized shear deformation theory for bending analysis of functionally graded plates. Applied Mathematical Modelling 30, 67-84. DOI 10.1016/j.apm.2005.03.009.
fg_sine_deflection.status: Verified reproduced values and row labels in Nguyen et al.; the exact table number in the original Zenkour paper remains unverified.
fg_sine_deflection.comparison_type: Different plate theory. Small low-g discrepancies do not establish same-theory identity; g=2,4,10 are contextual values, not acceptance targets for this FSDT solver.

fg_tsdt_frequency.quantity: omega_hat = omega_11*h*sqrt(rho_c/E_c), fundamental frequency, simply supported square plate
fg_tsdt_frequency.source: Belkhodja, Y., Ouinas, D., Zaoui, F.Z. and Fekirini, H. (2020). An exponential-trigonometric higher order shear deformation theory (HSDT) for bending, free vibration, and buckling analysis of functionally graded materials (FGMs) plates. Advanced Composites Letters 29.
fg_tsdt_frequency.location: Table 5, a/h = 5, mode 1(1,1), row 'TSDT (Hosseini-Hashemi et al.)'; the same row is quoted in Table 3 of an eight-unknown shear deformation FE paper (ResearchGate 311267843) next to an FSDT row 0.2108, 0.1802, 0.1629, 0.1396, 0.1322
fg_tsdt_frequency.attributed_original: Hosseini-Hashemi et al. (Reddy third-order theory, exact closed form), as cited in the source above.
fg_tsdt_frequency.status: Found on 9 November 2026 through search-result excerpts of the two secondary sources; the column-to-g mapping is taken from the ResearchGate table. Neither the full secondary tables nor the original Hosseini-Hashemi table were inspected.
fg_tsdt_frequency.comparison_type: Same theory (Reddy TSDT) rounded literature values: contextual agreement check to the printed 4 digits. Primary verification of the TSDT mass matrix is the FSDT limit and the independent symbolic Ritz derivation.

analytical_references.thin_uniform: Independent CPT double-series center sum: 16/pi^6 * sum over odd m,n of sin(m*pi/2)*sin(n*pi/2)/[m*n*(m^2+n^2)^2]; cutoff 999 used. Rounded handoff literal was 0.00406235; no verified book edition/page was supplied.
analytical_references.constant_nu_static: Schur complement of coupled FSDT matrix: Dstar=D11-B11^2/A11; W=Q/[Dstar*(alpha^2+beta^2)^2]+Q/[As*(alpha^2+beta^2)]. Analytical same-theory check, not a paper-table value.
analytical_references.uniform_truncation: Same-theory reference recomputed at cutoff 199 for legacy scalar convergence checks; pilot compares cutoff 49 against 99 for all five grid fields.
analytical_references.ritz: Independent symbolic energy derivation in validation/ritz_crosscheck.py with adaptive thickness integration; no external numeric literal or paper table.
